# Michael Willi

> Michael Willi is a sophomore at Indiana University Bloomington, Class of 2029, and a founder. He is recruiting for Summer 2027 and Summer 2028 internships in venture capital, private equity, and growth equity, with sector interests in software, consumer packaged goods (CPG), and deep tech. He founded three companies in 2026 (Impact Margin, Brine Prospect, and Uh Oh), is in the technology cohort of the IU Innovates Incubator, and wrote a venture thesis on lithium from Permian Basin produced water. He is based in Bloomington, Indiana during the school year and Austin, Texas in the summer.

## Pages

- [Home](https://michaelwilli.com/): What he is recruiting for, sector interests, companies, underwriting and research, the Growth Equity Masterclass and Wall Street Prep certificates, education, and contact links.
- [About Michael Willi](https://michaelwilli.com/about): The long version in his own words: each company, research and underwriting, training, education, quick facts, and common questions.

## Key facts

- Recruiting for: Summer 2027 and Summer 2028 internships in venture capital, private equity, and growth equity. Focused on venture capital and private equity, and also highly motivated by growth equity.
- Sector interests: Software (from the technology cohort of the IU Innovates Incubator and the web apps he has shipped), CPG (his Merchandising degree, direct-to-consumer brands from 2020 to 2024, and Uh Oh), and deep tech (his venture thesis on lithium from oilfield wastewater).
- School: Indiana University Bloomington, B.S. in Merchandising with a Product Development concentration (Eskenazi School), Business Minor (Kelley School of Business), Class of 2029. 4.0 GPA, Executive Dean's List (Spring 2026).
- Training: Working through Mike Hinckley's Growth Equity Masterclass (https://growthequityinterviewguide.com/), expected December 2026. Its seven modules cover an introduction to growth investing, valuation, a paper LBO, full LBO models, growth-specific modeling (pre- and post-money valuation, option pools, liquidation preferences, SaaS metrics), a mock sourcing cold call, and a market thesis. Holds two Wall Street Prep certificates: Accounting & Financial Statement Analysis (November 2026) and Excel Basics (September 2026). The credential links are on his LinkedIn profile.
- Now: Founder of Uh Oh (https://uhohbrands.com/), a pre-launch zinc cold remedy brand built in the IU Innovates Incubator. The product is a quick-dissolve tablet meant to be taken at the first sign of a cold. The site and waitlist are live, and nothing has shipped.
- Previously: Founder of Brine Prospect (October 2026), a mail-in lithium test kit for oilfield brine with a lithium lease value calculator, pitched at the IU Innovates pitch competition and stopped after customer discovery showed operators already get lithium in their free water analysis. Founder of Impact Margin (April to September 2026), software that read a business's operating and utility bills and flagged overbilling, cost spikes, and late fees, with one paying customer. Direct-to-consumer brands in apparel and sporting goods (2020 to 2024).
- Research and underwriting: "Reduce, Reuse, Recycle... Profit?", a venture thesis on lithium from Permian Basin produced water that sizes the opportunity at $2.5 to $6 billion of theoretical annual feedstock value, second edition July 2026. Two self-directed multifamily underwritings in Bloomington, Indiana: a 12-unit acquisition (April 2026) and a 16-unit apartment-to-condo conversion at $1.89 million (September 2026). A Roblox player retention study, a survey of 59 Indiana University students (October 2026).
- Recognition: 4.0 GPA, Executive Dean's List, Eagle Scout.
- Outside of work: Weightlifting, golf, runs, Indiana football.
